# Test fixtures: provenance

All files are copied unmodified from upstream repositories (fetched
2026-11-26). Each directory carries the upstream licence. Negative test cases
are derived *in the test code* by mutating copies in memory; the files here
are never edited. Recorded collateral that we fetched ourselves is listed
separately.

Notes:

* `dstack/tdx-lite-getquote.json` is a raw dstack guest-agent v0 `GetQuote`
  response captured upstream from a dstack-0.6.0-rc0 CVM (2 vCPU, 2 GiB,
  QEMU 8.2.2, `report_data` = 64 × `0x42`, key provider `none`). It has no
  collateral and no app-compose document.
* `sev/report_milan.hex` is a hex-encoded 1184-byte SEV-SNP attestation
  report signed by `vcek_milan.der`; ARK/ASK come from the `sev` crate's
  built-in Milan certificates.

Collateral is Intel-signed; tests verify it offline at `recorded_at_unix`.

## Synthetic (generated by us, NOT vendor-signed)

`sev-synthetic/` holds a test-only certificate chain made by
`sev-synthetic/gen.sh` on 2026-11-27 (OpenSSL 4.1.0): `ark.pem`, `ask.pem`
(RSA-PSS/SHA-384), `vcek.der` (P-384, TCB and hwID extensions equal to
`sev/report_milan.hex`) and `vcek.key.hex`, the "VCEK" private scalar,
public on purpose. None of it is AMD's. The verifier accepts this chain only
in `cfg(test)` builds (`snp::roots`); release builds know only the AMD roots
built into the `sev` crate. Tests (`src/snp_tests.rs`) use it to re-sign
copies of the Milan report with chosen `HOST_DATA`, `MEASUREMENT`,
`REPORT_DATA` and policy bits, because no real SNP report with a non-zero
`HOST_DATA` is available to this project.

| `gcp-cs/live-2026-11-27.document.json` | The attestation document served by `https://vault.gcp.facundo.dev` on 2026-11-27, with a real Google-signed token (production Confidential Space image 261100, c3-standard-4, Intel TDX; the VM no longer exists). Public data. Checked against the key set above at a pinned clock inside the token's one-hour validity, and against `policy/2026.11.0-gcp-cs-dev.toml`. | `c32ddbd507844201b463ea549769dd4d0d0f4c5c48e7446688b053e492031b62` |
| `gcp-cs/live-debug-2026-11-27.document.json` | Same workload digest, VM recreated on the `confidential-space-debug` image family the same day. Real token; must FAIL (`dbgstat` enabled, no support attributes). | `e4594465042f1baf10ddae0b4d14276c12a18587fddfb81f71047ebe67ab80c9` |

The two `live-*` documents are the only real Confidential Space tokens
recorded (one live test, 2026-11-27, docs/GCP_CONFIDENTIAL_SPACE.md section
10). The claim shapes of the fake tokens in the other tests follow Google's
token claims reference.
